review_comments: This comment might be because of something I'm doing in my LB PR. But from what I can see, the node cert is created first here, and tends to always have the same arguments, which are the "nodeNames" (IPs & hostnames). I'm curious if we can share it, and have it in a common place. Mostly my ask since I need to update this cert when a cluster is growing, or a load balancer IP needs to be added to it.

Just to make sure I'm following: are you talking about the duplicate `create-node` call in the functions that set up system vs app tenants?

We could clean this up, but might be better to do it in isolation. Unless I misunderstand what you are requesting, please let me know.
Yes, I think it was present prior to this PR in any case. But all in all it would be nice to only have to update one node cert, if possible.

> to only have to update one node cert

Do you have to update multiple node certs? I was under the impression this was not creating a new cert, but I haven't looked closely.

In any case, I think it would make more sense to fix this in a separate PR and keep this PR focused on porting the `multitenant-fairness` test.
Makes sense, can be done in another PR.
